title: ImgMT: Wikipedia-based Dataset For Evaluating Text-in-Image Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs.   We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English->X and X->English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. translated_title: ImgMT：基于维基百科的图像内文本翻译评估数据集
translated_abstract: 图像内文本翻译旨在翻译嵌入图像中的所有文本内容。在文本图像翻译（TIT）中，输出的是翻译后的文本；而图像内机器翻译（IIMT）则进一步将翻译结果渲染回图像中。我们提出了ImgMT，这是一个大规模多语言数据集和基准，从Wikimedia Commons上的本地化SVG插图中挖掘而成，专注于图表、地图和信息图。ImgMT包含35,612个对齐的图像对，分为1,855个图像集，涵盖129种语言、20多种书写系统以及4,886个语言对。我们提出了一个多层次评估协议，同时衡量源端的文本区域检测和OCR准确率以及目标端的翻译质量。我们在英语到X和X到英语的设置下，对多个多模态大语言模型和一个专门的TIT系统进行了基准测试，发现源语言和书写系统会显著影响TIT质量。最后，我们展示了ImgMT（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了ImgMT，一个从维基共享资源SVG插图中挖掘的大规模多语言图像内文本翻译数据集与基准，涵盖129种语言和4,886个语言对，并配合多层次评估协议发现源语言和书写系统会显著影响翻译质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ImgMT, a massively multilingual text-in-image translation dataset and benchmark mined from Wikimedia Commons SVG illustrations, covering 129 languages and 4,886 language pairs, with a multi-level evaluation protocol showing that source language and writing system substantially affect translation quality.
